messages:
marta: Morning async — quick SRE check-in.

What I did:
- triaged EU KV cache warmup spike and rolled back kv-prefetch tweak
- ran a focused load test to validate steady-state p50/p95

Blockers:
- alert noise: `latency_slo_alert` keeps firing on warmup pattern, needs debounce/window adjustment
- infra PR blocking rollout (https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/123)

Today:
- update runbook + alert debounce PR
- review infra PR and ping owner
- coordinate with oncall for synthetic to detect warmups

ken: thanks — can you share the sample request that correlated with the spike?

marta: sure, quick repro snippet:
```
# replay script
curl -XPOST https://api.redwood/encode -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"input":"<long prompt>", "batch_size":32, "seq_len":1024}'
# note: run with concurrency 6 to see warmup pattern
```

lin: oncall here. I received a pager at 06:12 UTC. stack shows `batcher` backlog + transient 5xx during warmup. muted alert for 15m to stop noise; we should tune sensitivity.

sre-bot: [ALERT] latency_slo_alert fired (service=runtime-eu, severity=warning, window=5m)

priya: on the infra PR I left a comment near `autoscaler.go:178` — we should add a `min_scale_duration` to avoid immediate scale-down during warmup

ken: +1 to priya. propose `min_scale_duration: 300s` and a soft-scale policy for the first 10 minutes after deploy

marta: actions:
- jameel (PR owner) to add cooldown + retry logic on infra PR (assignee: jameel)
- marta -> open PR for runbook tweak and alert debounce (link will be posted)
- ken/priya -> review infra PR and approve if cooldown added
- lin -> create a short synthetic (5min cadence) to detect warmup spikes and post results

lin: will create synthetic and post results in this thread within 2h

marta: great — I'll post runbook PR shortly. ping me if the pager fires again :thumbsup:
